original: WPRPLACE (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈhɔtn̥ˌstrandɪr̥]) is Iceland's northernmost peninsula, covering 580 km2 at the northern end of the Westfjords, to the north of the Jökulfirðir and to the northwest of Drangajökull glacier.
